text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain-based international investment group Investcorp acquires American baby clothing firm William Carter Co.
- Qatar's Al-Rayyan oilfield to go on stream within few days, operator Atlantic Richfiled Co (ARCO) said.
- Bahraini and Indian ministers of commerce discuss ways of developing commercial cooperation between the two countries.
- Real estate market looking healthy. Properties worth about six million dinars were sold in October.
